name: a reply notification lands at the right moment
looks: A small notification card slides in low in the frame showing a short, real-looking reply with a timestamp. A caption beneath it closes the loop, naming the moment someone else takes over.
build: The notification card slides/fades in from the edge (power3.out), holding briefly; the caption fades/rises in beneath it a beat later, one word in the accent colour.
sound: A soft notification chime as the card lands.
prompt: Slide a small notification card in low in the frame showing a short, real-looking reply with a timestamp, then fade in a caption beneath it naming the moment a person takes back over from the system, closing the loop the film opened.
